channel.title: AI Learnings
channel.description: The premier community-driven engineering portal and blog for AI Learnings, LLM reasoning architectures, autonomous agent workflows, production RAG, and MCP integrations.

item.title: Fine-Tuning vs RAG vs In-Context Prompting: The Engineering Decision Matrix
item.description: A definitive guide to choosing between parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA), retrieval-augmented generation, and long-context prompt engineering.

item.title: Agentic Design Patterns: Reflection, Planning, and Multi-Agent Orchestration
item.description: A comprehensive analysis of foundational design patterns for autonomous AI agents: ReAct loops, Reflexion self-critique, hierarchical supervisors, and swarm protocols.

item.title: Gemini 2.0 Flash & Real-Time Multimodal Agent Architectures
item.description: A technical evaluation of Gemini 2.0 Flash: native real-time audio and vision streaming, sub-second tool execution, and agentic workflows.

item.title: The Comprehensive Guide to Model Context Protocol (MCP)
item.description: Everything you need to know about Anthropic's open standard for connecting LLMs to databases, developer tools, internal APIs, and local resources.

item.title: DeepSeek-R1 Architecture Breakdown: Pure RL & Test-Time Compute
item.description: Comprehensive technical notes on DeepSeek-R1, Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA), DeepSeekMoE, and the emergence of reasoning via GRPO.

item.title: Modern Production RAG: Hybrid Search, Reranking & Contextual Retrieval
item.description: A battle-tested blueprint for architecting enterprise retrieval-augmented generation systems that eliminate hallucination and achieve >95% recall.

item.title: Top AI & ML Engineer System Design Interview Scenarios
item.description: Key architectural scenarios, trade-off questions, and technical answers for AI Engineer and Applied Scientist system design interviews.

item.title: Implementing Hybrid Vector Search with BM25 and Qdrant in Python
item.description: A complete practical guide to setting up hybrid search with dense embeddings, sparse lexical vectors, and reciprocal rank fusion.

item.title: Demystifying LLM Reasoning & Test-Time Compute: Inside R1, o1, and Beyond
item.description: An architectural deep dive into test-time compute scaling, reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), process reward models, and chain-of-thought search mechanisms.

item.title: Multi-Agent Orchestration Patterns: Hierarchical, Swarm, and Event-Driven
item.description: Architectural blueprints for structuring resilient multi-agent AI topologies, preventing state synchronization conflicts, and optimizing execution latency.

item.title: Deterministic Agent Intent Router & Tool Classifier Prompt
item.description: A fast, low-token router prompt for classifying user requests into specialized downstream agent topics and selecting appropriate tool sets.

item.title: Building a Production-Ready SQLite MCP Server in TypeScript
item.description: A hands-on tutorial on developing, packaging, and testing a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes database exploration tools to LLMs.

item.title: Structured Chain-of-Thought & Self-Reflection System Prompt
item.description: A production-tested system prompt template that forces LLMs to reason step-by-step, self-audit edge cases, and emit valid JSON schemas.

item.title: Transformer Attention & The KV Cache: Memory Footprint and Optimization
item.description: A deep dive into Multi-Head Attention, Grouped-Query Attention (GQA), FlashAttention-3, and PagedAttention memory management in LLM serving.

item.title: Building an Autonomous Tool-Calling Agent from Scratch in Python
item.description: A hands-on step-by-step developer tutorial implementing an agentic execution loop with tool registration, memory management, and error handling.
